Hi Elaine —

Thanks for the clear note and the file — helpful. Short answers up front:

- The ingestion surcharge applies to raw trace ingestion (compressed span bundles) only when peak onboarding is substantially above your steady-state forecast. Processed indexes/dashboards are metered separately as part of the Advanced Dashboards add-on.

- We can absolutely discuss amortizing the onboarding surcharge across a prepaid commitment (12 months). Typical approach is a one-time onboarding fee that we credit across the first N invoices or fold into the committed Monthly Recurring Revenue (MRR) for a discounted blended rate.

I put Vanessa and Karthik on cc to propose two options (quick proposals below) — once you confirm which you'd like to model, we'll produce a line-item SOW and example invoice schedule.

Option A — Upfront credit amortization (recommended for early heavy ingest):
- One-time onboarding surcharge invoiced in month 1, with a 12-month credit schedule applied to monthly invoices (equal monthly credit until fully amortized).
- 10% discount on Advanced Dashboards for the first 6 months.

Option B — Blended committed rate (recommended for predictable billing):
- Increase committed MRR to cover onboarding so month-1 invoice doesn't spike; blended unit price for ingestion and dashboards applied across months.
- No upfront surcharge; 6% term discount on total committed spend.

What would help: a quick steady-state estimate (month 3+ monthly TB) so we can test the blended model. Vanessa — could you pull the 12-month sample invoice for both options and attach the SOW draft? Karthik — can you flag any perf/cost risk if Healthlytics chooses ingestion-heavy onboarding in month 1?

Happy to hop on a 30-min call if that speeds things up.

— Sofia

- If your month-1 ingest is 30–45 TB and steady-state is ~4–6 TB/mo afterward, Option A (one-time surcharge with 12-month credit) limits sticker shock while keeping unit economics aligned to usage. For the numbers you gave, month-1 invoice under Option A is 65% lower than an unamortized surcharge.

- Option B smooths billing but raises committed MRR by ~18% vs your current forecast. If you need predictable capex for budgeting, Option B is cleaner for procurement.

Concessions we can offer for a 12-month Dedicated commit:
- Waive the onboarding surcharge on up to 10 TB of ingestion if you sign within 14 days.
- 12% discount on Advanced Dashboards for the full term (instead of our standard 8%) if you take a 12-month Dedicated + Dashboards bundle.

Samir / Elaine —

Answers inline below and next steps at the bottom.

1) Waived 10 TB — applies to compressed span ingestion only (what you ship into the collector). Processed storage from aggregation/derived metrics is charged under the Advanced Dashboards SKU; we'll make that explicit in the SOW.

2) Credits vs amortization — yes, we can issue pre-paid ingestion credits (usable against raw ingestion) instead of invoice-line amortization. Credits are consumed FIFO and will appear on your usage report as a negative line item until exhausted. We'll include a credits appendix to the SOW showing expiry (12 months) and usage rules.

3) Retention delta — pricing for Advanced Dashboards scales with retention window roughly as follows (per your projected dashboard/query volume):
   - 30d: base unit price (reference in deck)
   - 90d: +18% unit uplift vs 30d
   - 365d: +55% unit uplift vs 30d (due to storage and query cache sizing)

Concession recap (to accelerate signature):
- 10 TB onboarding waiver (compressed ingest) if LOI signed within 14 days
- Pre-paid ingestion credit option in lieu of amortization (12-month expiry)
- 12% discount on Advanced Dashboards for 12-month Dedicated commit
